nom: Philosophy Anti-Wrinkle Miracle Worker+ Line Correcting Eye Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: one with extremely oily skin found it glided on lightly and turned almost water-like with no greasy residue, while others with oily skin found it too heavy and reported pilling.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report strong hydration and relief from tightness or flaking, including one prone to eczema flare-ups who found the thick texture especially soothing.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report mixed but mostly positive results: some found it balanced dry and oily areas well and felt gentle, though one felt it was heavy and greasy at first and another developed a few pimples while using it.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, eczema, or retinoid-related reactivity, mostly report no burning, redness, or irritation where other products had failed them; a few reviewers, however, had negative reactions, including one whose rosacea flared, one who broke out and found it too oily for her acne-prone, sensitive skin, and one who noticed milia afterward.
segments.mature: Reviewers who state their age, ranging from their early 40s to early 50s, generally report softened fine lines and brighter, more hydrated skin within a few weeks, though the degree of visible wrinkle improvement varies and one reports no change in redness.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers who comment on wrinkles report visibly softer, less prominent fine lines within one to a few weeks, especially around the forehead, eyes, and mouth, along with brighter, more even-toned skin. However, a substantial number report no noticeable change in their wrinkles or fine lines despite weeks of consistent use, even though they often still praise the moisture it provides.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report strong, lasting hydration, waking up with soft, plump, moisturized skin even in winter; a couple of reviewers, however, found a thin layer left their skin feeling under-hydrated or dry unless they applied more product.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea-prone or reactive skin, report reduced redness and a more even skin tone; however, one reviewer's rosacea flared after use, and another says it did not improve her redness at all.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including several with reactive skin or a retinoid routine, report no burning, stinging, or irritation and say it layers well as a buffer on retinoid nights; a few reviewers, however, experienced a rosacea flare-up, breakouts, irritation from balled-up residue, or milia.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some with acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts; a couple, however, describe new pimples or a breakout after starting the cream, though one was unsure whether it was caused by the product or hormonal factors.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the cream as absorbing well without a greasy residue, including one with extremely oily skin who found it turned almost water-like on application; several others, however, especially among the more critical reviews, describe it as greasy, pore-clogging, or leaving skin looking oily.

aspects.libelle: Leaves a residue that balls up when rubbed
Expensive relative to results for some
Small amount needed, jar lasts a long time

extraits.titre: Not good for my acne prone/sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I received these products for free from Influenster and brands) in exchange for my honest review. I've always enjoy Philosophy's Purity cleanser, daily Microdermabrasion and body wash. But for some reason, their moisturizer is not good for my acne prone/sensitive skin. It is a bit greasy and leaves my skin very oily. And it starts to break me out, so i have to discontinue using it.

extraits.titre: I didn't see any difference except the pilling on
extraits.texte: I was excited to use this product, but after nearly a month, I have only experienced a flare with my rosacea, no change to any wrinkles￼, and I don't know if it is because I use a black silk pillowcase but every morning I would see pilling on my pillowcase that wasn't there prior to using this product. Definitely not something I will be using in the future..

The texture is somewhat thick, like a nice whipped lotion. Surprisedly, this product didn't make my skin break out during the couple weeks of usage. Bonus for that! However, I don't think this is suitable for oily skin, which I have, since I've experienced some pillings in spite of all efforts. My recommendation - try if you have dry, and perhaps sensitive, skin. It's a nice product.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion. First off, I don't really have many wrinkles on my face, so I can't attest to that aspect. I can say that I have sensitive skin with lots of redness (possibly rosacea) and this did not irritate it. The consistency of this product is so soft and smooth going on, almost like a pudding. I didn't use it in conjunction with any other products and it absorbed very well. My skin does appear to be brighter and have a healthier glow about it. My skin also feels smooth after using this. The jar has a very substantial glass feel, which I like better than the plastic ones I've had from other producers. Overall, I have no complaints and will probably repurchase after this jar is empty.

extraits.titre: Wake up to silky smooth skin
extraits.texte: I have extremely oily skin, so I needed a moisturizer that would give my skin the hydration I need. This moisturizer glides onto my skin and as I work it in, it almost becomes water-like. There is no greasy residue with this cream or stickiness. When I wake up in my morning, my skin feels nice and plump.

I enjoyed using the product. I have pretty dry skin, especially around this time of the year, and am prone to eczema flare-ups in the winter. The Philosophy moisturizer was very thick, which I loved because it provided me with the hydration needed for my skin type. There is a very light scent that was not at all irritating. I'll be continuing to use this product.

extraits.titre: Philosophy is one of my favorite brands, and this
extraits.texte: As a woman with aging skin, I am always on the lookout for something that may help me look younger. Philosophy's overnight face cream, which contains hyaluronic acid, has honestly made my skin more hydrated as evidenced by reduction in fine lines after using it for a month, before I go to sleep. Also, this did not cause any irritation or breakouts, as many products do due to my sensitive skin. I will definitely be purchasing this! Note: I did receive a sample of this product in exchange for a review. However I will most certainly be purchasing it, as I did notice my skin was no longer flat and dry, and the fine lines in my 41 year old skin definitely decreased after only a couple of weeks of nightly use.
